messages:
jordyn: Quick morning Q — someone nabbed the last blueberry muffin? If it was you, confess. Also: tiny game to start Friday — drop your snack pick + a one-line comeback. Example: 'muffin + Nice try, crumbs don't lie.' :muffin:
max: guilty. I took it, but leaving crumb evidence. 😬 Granola is my backup.
lucy: banana 🍌 — one-liner: 'I'd explain, but your brain's buffering.'
teo: muffin > sorry not sorry :sunglasses: — 'You're not late, you're fashionably irrelevant.'
ops-bot: poll created: muffin / banana / granola / mystery cookie — vote with reactions (:muffin:, :banana:, :nut_and_berry:, :cookie:)
sam: @jordyn I'll slap a fridge sticker: `FRIDGE: LABEL YOUR TREASURE`
mika: mystery cookie — 'I'd agree with you but then we'd both be wrong.'
jordyn: tally so far — max 👍, lucy 🍌, teo 🧁, mika 🍪. Fridge sticker deployed. Winner gets 24-hour bragging rights.
lucy: :trophy: Prize suggestion: the office plant gets a tiny hat for the week. Best comeback gets to pick the hat.
teo: :rofl: tiny crown, yes. Also can we add a sticky that says 'Do not eat my vibes'?
max: crown for the plant. Also, I will accept any crumbs as tribute. :pray:
mika: I volunteer to make the plant a ceremonial throne. Photos mandatory.
sam: noted — janitorial has been cc'd (kidding). Enjoy your weekend warm-up, team. :slightly_smiling_face:
